title: Disjoint-Block Coherent 2^a-Tree Receiver: Physical-Wire Capacity Inequality, Polynomial-Sample Depth Ceiling, and Joint List-Width AM-GM Tradeoff

theorems.statement: In any disjoint-block 2^a-tree over an N_bits-bit group where each of the k = 2^a leaves supplies L_list = 2^{b_bits} (b_bits = ceil(N_bits / (a + 1))) distinct non-empty supports inside its m_leaf-wire block, C(m_leaf, floor(m_leaf / 2)) >= 2^{b_bits} forces m_leaf >= m_leaf^min(b_bits) >= b_bits + 1 and total physical phase-qubit width K_wires(a, N_bits) >= 2^a m_leaf^min(b_bits) >= 2^a (b_bits + 1).

Under any phase-qubit budget K >= 2, every feasible disjoint-block tree depth a in A(K, N_bits) = {a >= 0 : 2^a m_leaf^min(ceil(N_bits / (a + 1))) <= K} satisfies a <= floor(log_2 K), and the minimum oblivious-join record-complexity exponent satisfies E_obliv^min(K, N_bits) = min_{a in A(K, N_bits)} (a + ceil(N_bits / (a + 1))) >= N_bits / (floor(log_2 K) + 1).

Across all unconstrained integer tree depths a >= 0, the oblivious-join record exponent E(a, N_bits) = a + ceil(N_bits / (a + 1)) satisfies E(a, N_bits) >= ceil(2 * sqrt(N_bits)) - 1, attained at a* in {floor(sqrt(N_bits)) - 1, ceil(sqrt(N_bits)) - 1}, where required physical wire width is K_wires(a*, N_bits) >= 2^{a*} (ceil(N_bits / (a* + 1)) + 1) = 2^{Theta(sqrt(N_bits))}.
